import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%Y')
a = df[df.account_id=='frHBxlu'].copy()
ad = pd.Timestamp('2025-10-13')
# day-of-week matched baseline: same weekday, preceding
prev = a[a.date<ad].copy()
prev['wd'] = prev.date.dt.dayofweek
base_dates = [d for d in sorted(prev.date.unique()) if pd.Timestamp(d).dayofweek==ad.dayofweek]
print('baseline dates', base_dates)
b = prev[prev.date.isin(base_dates)]
for col in ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']:
    cur = a[a.date==ad].groupby(col).unblended_cost.sum()
    bs = b.groupby('date')[col].size()  # rows per date
    base_mean = b.groupby(col).unblended_cost.sum()/len(base_dates)
    delta = (cur - base_mean).dropna()
    delta = delta.sort_values()
    print('===',col, 'total delta', round(cur.sum()-base_mean.sum(),2))
    print(delta[delta.abs()>delta.abs().max()*0.15])
